items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: Breadcrumb 'Workspace / Contracts / CT-2025-048' ends with the number but is plain <span> text, not links; the only way back is the '← All contracts' button, which calls workspace('All contracts') and opens a 'demo' modal instead of going to the list. Header does show CT-2025-048, vendor 'Meridian Cloud Solutions', 'Active' badge and four key fields.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: The filled primary button in the header is 'Edit contract' (bg-forest) beside a secondary 'Export'. Edit is the primary action, and there is no overflow menu and no terminate action. Renewal sits in a side panel as a second filled button.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: Sarah Reynolds '· Primary', Account director, href="mailto:sarah.reynolds@...", href="tel:+14155550128"; Michael Chen, Technical success manager, with mailto and tel links.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Table has Due date, Amount ($60,000) and Status columns, but audit reports numeric-align and tabular-nums failures on all 4 amount cells (left-aligned, font-variant-numeric normal). Rows are in chronological order, so the 3 paid ones come first and the upcoming Q4 payment is last.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Status chip text '• Upcoming' on the Q4 row (and '✓ Paid' on the others); the table footer says 'Next payment of $60,000 is due in 10 days.' The chip says only 'Upcoming', with no day count.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: 'Expiration date December 31, 2026' and the period card 'Jan 01 — Dec 31, 2026 · 56 days remaining'; the Renewal watch panel says 'This contract ends in 56 days.' Notice deadline 'Nov 1, 2026' is shown as passed.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: Rows show 'AMD-002 · October 12, 2026', a title and a summary in the expandable details. No approver is named, only 'Signed by both parties'. Amendments added through the form show no number, date or approver.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No empty, loading or error states anywhere in the markup or script. All sections are populated from static data, and the audit reports 0 loading placeholders.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: There is no terminate action or confirmation dialog. The only dialog is the generic modal#modal, used for edit, add amendment and renew.

notes: Audit score 36/100. Violations: text-contrast x84, numeric-align, tabular-nums, emoji-icon (glyph arrows and symbols used as icons, e.g. '↗', '▦', '✳'), font-size-base, table-row-height, type-scale (9 sizes). Uppercase tracked labels: 'WORKSPACE', 'YOUR WORKSPACE', 'RENEWAL WATCH', 'CONTRACT / CT-2025-048'. The navigation and 'All contracts' buttons only open a placeholder modal. Contract detail is otherwise reasonably clean: no gradient, glass, KPI icon tiles, hover-lift or oversized radius. The 'Renewal watch' side panel has a tinted card with a chatty headline, but it is not a promo card. Contact avatars are initials but they are real people.
